Name: The Sushi Project
Author: BeazNees
Description:
[center][img]https://proxy.duckduckgo.com/iu/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fi.imgur.com%2FV0HzhNi.png[/img][/center]
[color=#616161][size=2]﻿﻿
[/size][/color][size=3]This mods adds 34 Sushi recipes to the game. 

Using Rice, Seaweed and a multitude of fish (as well as other mischievous ingredients) you too can live your sushi dreams!
All recipes use vanilla ingredients!

The recipes as well as a few random assortment of sushi is available trough the vendor. 
The vendor comes to town on [b]Tuesdays & Saturdays, 6am to 8pm, on the arrowhead island in the forest[/b], above the Hat Mouse.*

[/size][size=2]* Some mods change the layout of the forest, so the location might be a little different with mods that edit the forest

Please note that some creative liberties were taken, as some of the dishes include fish which simply don't exist in Stardew Valley. Feel free to suggest a better alternative in the comments though, I love feedback.

Some of the item descriptions contain puns and jokes, and for that I am not sorry.

Some of the sushi items are tagged as [i]haram and/or tref[/i] based on the fish used, I tried to use the most common schools of thought for both. 
I used [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_halal_and_kosher_fish]this wikipedia list[/url], [url=https://www.ka.org.au/consumer-resources/common-kosher-and-non-kosher-fish]this blog post[/url] and [url=https://wehalal.co/blog/can-fish-be-halal/]this article [/url]to determine which fish are tagged as such. 

[/size][size=3][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Vrbras3FTTdalsqcCNvh7gitqnaunLWLhtHgpEiL_4o/edit?usp=sharing]Stardew Fish Halal & Kosher Spreadsheet[/url][/size][size=3] (made by me)

[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/nM215nt3/features.png[/img][/center]

34 types of sushi recipes, available to make in the kitchen. 
Support for custom NPC gift tastes supports For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16326]The Fishmonger[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] (only for Lady Sheba atm, feel free to suggest others) & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url] (only for Jessie)﻿﻿﻿﻿

The gift tastes are as follows:
﻿
[spoiler][b]General:[/b]
MOST of the sushi items are listed as normal cooking items; universally liked (except for Krobus, who dislikes them)
Niji is a universal love (except for Haley, who hates it)

[b]Special NPC gift tastes:[/b]
[i]Evelyn [/i]hates any sushi with fish in it, as her vanilla gift tastes indicates she hates fish.
[i]Jessie [/i]hates any sushi with animal products, as she is vegan. 
[i]Willy[/i] ,[i]Constance, Jorts, Jean, Mister Ginger and Lady Sheba [/i]love any sushi item with fish in it [/spoiler]

If you're the mod author for custom NPC/s and want special gift tastes for my sushi, please let me know, I love hearing from people.

[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/NnrwfyxP/faq.png[/img][/center][/size][size=4]

[b][i]Is this mod compatible with [insert mod name here]?[/i][/b][/size][size=3]

The short answer: I don't know.
The long answer: It should be, unless the mod edits the forest map to a degree where the area I spawn my stall in to be inaccessible. In which case, I'm in no rush to fix that, per say. I understand people want mods to be compatible, and I understand that to a degree. But I'm just one person, and don't want to overthink this mod I made for fun to it plays well with other mods. Mods that edit maps can change, and the prospect of editing my own mod just to make it so seems a bit tiring to me.
As far as other mods that add food/anything else, they are compatible, as I use custom unique names for my items. 
[/size][size=4]
[b][i]Where is the stall?[/i][/b][/size][size=3]

Arrow head island in the forest, few steps above the hat mouse (see mod images) on Tuesdays & Saturdays. The coordinators themselves won't change but it might look different if you use any mods that edits the forest map.

[left]For your convenience, the mod features an i18n file, allowing you to add translations! More info about providing translations for the mod can be
found [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations#How_to_translate_a_mod]here[/url].

[list]
[*]You are allowed to publish translations as a separate mod as long as it only contains the i18n file and nothing else
[*]You have to set the mod file type to a translation. It'll automatically
show up in the translations on the main page this way as well[*]You are allowed and encouraged to earn Donation Points for translations
[*]You have to add my mod as a dependency on your translation mod's page
[/list][/left]
